controlling_falsification.conclusion: Execution is qualified, but the narrow 3112-row and 142949-teacher-token acquisition surface did not produce broad fluent behavior.

hypothesis: Continuing the exact fast three-block LayerCake lineage on materially broader teacher responses grounded only in diverse fictional or supplied context will improve natural fluency without importing specialist facts or changing the sparse execution graph.

raw_corpus.promotion_restriction: Research evidence only until the raw corpus license is independently resolved.

catalog.selection: stable minimum SHA-256 by split and seed

segregation.teacher_output_policy: Reject source rows containing any starter-ontology core exclusion marker with token boundaries.
segregation.claim_boundary: Marker filtering and supplied-context construction are bounded corpus controls; they do not prove absolute zero latent world knowledge.

decision_rules: Use only passing search rows for training; validation and final teacher outputs never enter training.
Do not use the disclosed 28-prompt natural audit to construct prompt-specific handlers, templates, or training rows.
Reject the candidate if broad natural behavior, grounding, coherence, or repetition collapse does not materially improve.
Reject any candidate that changes the canonical ABI or sparse LayerCake graph.

Promotion still requires the corrected synthetic suite, natural-language evaluation, at least 2x optimized CPU-transformer throughput, 95% Phase-2 throughput retention, TTFT, RSS, identity, physical sparsity, and adversarial verification.
Teacher-quality equivalence is claimed only if a preregistered paired natural evaluation supports it; fluent-but-below-teacher is reported honestly as an intermediate result.
